Q1: Which branch should the fix be made on?
Choices:
A) PR #6572's head branch `ai/issue-6506`. Planning treats it as the target branch and adds a `Target branch: ai/issue-6506` line so `scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh` routes the fix PR there. The fix is the zero-argument loop rewrite of `test_judge_resume_from_unauthorized_author_is_ignored` and `test_revalidate_from_unauthorized_author_is_ignored`, keeping every assertion. The `pytest` import stays, because the default branch already imports it at line 22. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Leave this issue unimplemented and let PR #6572's own review/autofix editor fix the tests on its branch, using the failing-check context. Close this issue as a duplicate of that path.
C) The default branch. Also add a general guard (for example, a pre-commit or CI lint) that rejects `@pytest.mark.parametrize` in custom-runner test modules. The two failing tests on PR #6572 stay unfixed by this issue.
